# Code Review for Mathematical Modeling

Review the code for:

## Mathematical Correctness
- [ ] Formulas are correctly implemented
- [ ] Edge cases are handled (division by zero, etc.)
- [ ] Numerical stability is considered
- [ ] Results are validated against known solutions

## Code Quality
- [ ] Follows project coding standards
- [ ] Has appropriate documentation
- [ ] Uses meaningful variable names
- [ ] Is efficient and optimized

## Data Handling
- [ ] Input validation is present
- [ ] Missing values are handled
- [ ] Data transformations are documented
- [ ] Reproducibility is ensured (random seeds)

## Testing
- [ ] Unit tests are present
- [ ] Edge cases are tested
- [ ] Test coverage is adequate

Provide specific suggestions for improvements with code examples.
